---
title: "Labs"
---

Labs referenced by the Crossplane course. Course-scoped labs live under
`courses/crossplane/labs/`; reusable labs shared with other courses live
under the repository-root [`labs/`](../../../labs/index.html) directory.

## Referenced labs

- [Hello Pico](../../../labs/hello-pico/) — the introductory lab from the
  [Pico course](../../pico/index.html). Crossplane reuses the
  `hello-world-pico` artifact produced by this lab as the input to its
  Kubernetes composition. Descriptor:
  [`labs/hello-pico/metadata.yaml`](../../../labs/hello-pico/metadata.yaml).

::: {.callout-warning title="Crossplane Kubernetes lab — coming soon"}
The runnable Crossplane lab that composes Hello Pico onto a local
Kubernetes cluster (minikube) is being authored separately and is not
yet published as a learner page. Until it lands, treat this section as a
scaffold: the reusable Hello Pico lab above still runs stand-alone.
:::

## Authoring course-scoped labs

Course-scoped labs live in this directory and follow the shared lab
template. Reuse a repository-root lab when the same lab is useful for more
than one course.
